evidence_boundary.logical: source framebuffer IDs only; no physical claims
evidence_boundary.physical: typed human observations only; no machine ACK implies physical pass

observation.prompt: Set THEME=SIGNAL EDGE and LEDS=RAIL ECHO. Exercise the complete bounded cell: ordinary refresh with 0, 1, 2, and 3 direct-agent occupants; rapid encoder detents/clicks and direct keys 1-3 during menu and animation; BLOCKED, PENDING, FOCUSED, REJECTED/FAILED; menu open; brightness 10%, 80%, 100%; stale/offline and SYNC fences. Check exact orientation, 10% long text, brightness, LED zones, no blend/tear/black flash/ghosting, smooth complete frames, immediate opaque focus only, no replay, and display/LED semantic alignment. Answer Y only for a physical pass, N for a visible defect, or R when the observation cannot be performed.

With the guarded bridge live, cause simultaneous Herdr snapshot changes and Codex usage changes. Verify complete frames, no mixed generation, no remap, no input starvation, and exact focus identity.
Exercise Herdr stale/offline and Codex stale/offline transitions, then restore fresh data. Verify immediate fences, no queued/replayed press, and complete recovery without optimistic success.
Unplug/replug the USB data link once, then wait for the guarded bridge to republish. Verify all-panel SYNC, fresh hello/publication, and no stale action.
Use the normal firmware reset control. Verify all-panel SYNC through boot, fresh generation commit, unchanged deployment firmware/pair identity, and no focus replay.
Replace a generation while an ordinary reveal and focus request are active. Verify the old generation is discarded, the new complete generation wins, and no old binding or press is replayed.
Press direct keys 1-3 while turning/clicking the encoder on every menu page and animation state. Verify direct focus stays immediate and non-modal; menu cursor and preview remain causally correct.

Exercise the busiest animation and update load. Verify measured Full→Half→Static degradation before budget violation, semantic frames retained, bounded queue, zero per-frame allocation, and no input starvation.

At exact 10% brightness inspect every theme's longest title/discriminator, Codex reset/source/age, and ABOUT text. Verify 8 px metadata floor, ASCII ..., 4 px inset, no clipping, overlap, ticker, or bezel collision.

Inspect physical orientation, viewing angles, brightness/legibility, LED zones/alignment, blend artifacts, tearing, black flash, ghosting, smoothness, first press/encoder response, complete flush/reveal, cadence/duty, heap/block, queue, power method/headroom, and display/LED event alignment separately from machine framebuffer evidence.
